name: tutotuto
description: AI-powered drill grading app with handwriting support

scripts.test: npm run test:i18n && npm run test:grading-source && npm run test:server && npm run test:server-packaging
scripts.deploy:server: npm run prepare:server && gcloud run deploy hometeacher-api --project hometeacher-api --source .cloud-run --platform managed --region asia-northeast1 --allow-unauthenticated --min-instances 0 --max-instances 10 --memory 512Mi --cpu 1 --timeout 60s --update-env-vars NODE_ENV=production,GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3.8-flash --update-secrets GEMINI_API_KEY=GEMINI_API_KEY:latest,STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=STRIPE_SECRET_KEY:latest,STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET:latest,STRIPE_PRICE_ID=STRIPE_PRICE_ID:latest
scripts.deploy:server:staging: npm run prepare:server && gcloud run deploy hometeacher-api-staging --project hometeacher-api --source .cloud-run --platform managed --region asia-northeast1 --allow-unauthenticated --min-instances 0 --max-instances 5 --memory 512Mi --cpu 1 --timeout 60s --update-env-vars NODE_ENV=staging,GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3.8-flash --update-secrets GEMINI_API_KEY=GEMINI_API_KEY:latest,STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=STRIPE_SECRET_KEY:latest,STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET:latest,STRIPE_PRICE_ID=STRIPE_PRICE_ID:latest
